title: Rabbi Idi of Chutriya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Yirmiyah’s student and raised a difficulty to him, as in Shekalim, chapter 2, halakhah 5; Beitzah, chapter 2, halakhah 8; and Moed Katan, chapter 1, halakhah 2. He is also mentioned in Sheviit, chapter 3, halakhah 2, and at the end of Shabbat chapter 5.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rabbi Idi is Rabbi Yirmiyah’s pupil and the one raising the difficulty; the returned English had reversed the teacher-student relation.

The checked Jerusalem Talmud passages positively name Idi of Chutra/Chutriya, including his question before Rabbi Yirmiyah in Shekalim 2:5 and the basket-and-spade episode in Moed Katan 1:2 and Sheviit 3:2. Beitzah 2:8 and Shabbat chapter 5 also name him. Hyman’s teacher-student characterization remains his account, rather than a new relationship admission.
